hints: Decompose $1/[x(4-x)]$ into terms in $1/x$ and $1/(4-x)$, then integrate.
Use $(t,x)=(0,0.4)$ to determine the integration constant.
Use $(t,x)=(2,2)$ in the same logarithmic relation to determine $k$ exactly.
Substitute this $k$ back and combine the logarithms into a single ratio.
walkthrough:
Separate the variables in $\dfrac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t} = kx(4 - x)$:
$$\dfrac{1}{x(4 - x)}\,\mathrm{d}x = k\,\mathrm{d}t$$

Decompose the fraction into partial fractions $\dfrac{1}{x(4 - x)} = \dfrac{A}{x} + \dfrac{B}{4 - x}$:
$$1 = A(4 - x) + Bx$$
Setting $x = 0$ gives $4A = 1 \implies A = \dfrac{1}{4}$.
Setting $x = 4$ gives $4B = 1 \implies B = \dfrac{1}{4}$.
$$\dfrac{1}{4}\left(\dfrac{1}{x} + \dfrac{1}{4 - x}\right)\mathrm{d}x = k\,\mathrm{d}t \implies \left(\dfrac{1}{x} + \dfrac{1}{4 - x}\right)\mathrm{d}x = 4k\,\mathrm{d}t$$

Integrate both sides:
$$\ln x - \ln(4 - x) = 4kt + c \implies \ln\left(\dfrac{x}{4 - x}\right) = 4kt + c$$

Substitute the initial condition $t = 0$ and $x = 0.4$ to find $c$:
$$\ln\left(\dfrac{0.4}{4 - 0.4}\right) = 4k(0) + c \implies c = \ln\left(\dfrac{0.4}{3.6}\right) = \ln\left(\dfrac{1}{9}\right) = -\ln 9$$

Substitute the second condition $t = 2$ and $x = 2$ to find $k$:
$$\ln\left(\dfrac{2}{4 - 2}\right) = 4k(2) - \ln 9$$
$$\ln 1 = 8k - \ln 9 \implies 0 = 8k - \ln 9 \implies 8k = \ln 9$$

ai_rubric.Solving Separable Differential Equations: Separates variables and integrates the separated equation. Integrates and derives term $kt$, or equivalent. The final result is $\ln\frac{x}{4-x}=t\ln3-\ln9$ and $k=\frac14\ln3$.

hints: Convert 90% of the $4\,\mathrm{km}^2$ field into the corresponding infected area $x$.
Use logarithm laws to isolate $t$ and report the time in years.
walkthrough:
When $90\%$ of the field of area $4\,\mathrm{km}^2$ is infected, the infected area is:
$$x = 0.90 \times 4 = 3.6\,\mathrm{km}^2$$

Substitute $x = 3.6$ into the integrated relation $\ln\left(\dfrac{x}{4 - x}\right) = 4kt - \ln 9$ with $4k = \ln 3$:
$$\ln\left(\dfrac{3.6}{4 - 3.6}\right) = t\ln 3 - \ln 9$$

Simplify the argument of the logarithm:
$$\dfrac{3.6}{0.4} = 9$$

ai_rubric.Interpreting Differential-Equation Solut: Substitutes $x=3.6$ and solves for $t$. Gives $t=4$. The final result is $t=4$ years.
